gui = script.Parent.Parent.Parent --the Shop frame
tmi = gui.TooManyItems
enabled = gui.Enabled
player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
itempurchase = game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ItemBuyRequest

input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
touch = false
taps = 0
if input.TouchEnabled == true then
	touch = true
	gui.TouchNotice.Visible = true
end

function onMouseEnter()
	local desc = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemDesc")
	local cost = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemCost")
	if desc ~= nil and cost ~= nil then
		gui.Desc.ItemDesc.Text = desc.Value
		gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = "Price: $"..cost.Value
		gui.Desc.ItemName.Text = script.Parent.Name
	end
end

function onMouseButton1Click() --clone the item into their backpack
	itemsbought = gui.ItemsBought
	if touch then
		local desc = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemDesc")
		local cost = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemCost")
		if desc ~= nil and cost ~= nil then
			gui.Desc.ItemDesc.Text = desc.Value
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = "Price: $"..cost.Value
			gui.Desc.ItemName.Text = script.Parent.Name
		end
		taps = taps + 1
		if taps == 2 then
			taps = 0
			if enabled.Value == true then
			enabled.Value = false
			if player:DistanceFromCharacter(gui.Parent.Parent.ShopPos.Value) < 25 then
				if player:findFirstChild("Backpack") ~= nil then
					tools = player.Backpack:GetChildren()
					if #tools < 10 then
						
							if itemsbought.Value < 6 then
								local purchase = itempurchase:InvokeServer(gui.Parent.Parent.Name,script.Parent.Name)
								if purchase then
									itemsbought.Value = itemsbought.Value + 1
								else
									tmi.Text = "You do not have enough cash! You can earn some cash over time, or purchase more in the Game Pass Shop."
									tmi.Visible = true
									wait(4)
									tmi.Visible = false
								end
							else
								tmi.Text = "You are buying a lot of items - please wait and give the other customers a chance!"
								tmi.Visible = true
								wait(6)

local Tool = script.Parent;
local Ball = Tool.Handle
local ms = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

enabled = true
function onButton1Down(mouse)
	if not enabled then
		return
	end

	enabled = false
	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunWaitCursor.png"

	wait(.2)
	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunCursor.png"
	enabled = true

end

function onEquippedLocal(mouse)


	if mouse == nil then
		print("Mouse not found")
		return 
	end
	Tool.Enabled = true

	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunCursor.png"
	mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end)
end

Tool.Enabled = true
Tool.Activated:connect(function()
	if ms == nil or not Tool.Enabled then
		return
	end
	local character = Tool.Parent;
	local humanoid = character.Humanoid
	if humanoid == nil then
		print("Humanoid not found")
		return 
	end
	local targetPos = ms.Hit.p
	local lookAt = (targetPos - character.Head.Position).unit
	Tool.ThrowBall:FireServer(lookAt)
	wait(2)
end)


Tool.Equipped:connect(onEquippedLocal)

	gui:TweenPosition(gui.Position + UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),"Out", "Quad", .6)

coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
	while mainframe ~= nil do
		for _,bg in pairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
			if bg.Name == "BGFrame" then
				local basecolor = {(100 + (bg.Position.Y.Scale * 60))/255,(160 + (bg.Position.Y.Scale * 60))/255,1} --with possible offset of 13
				local newcolor = Color3.new(bg.BackgroundColor3.r + math.random(-1,1)/255,bg.BackgroundColor3.g + math.random(-1,1)/255,1)
				if newcolor.r > basecolor[1] - 15/255 and newcolor.r < basecolor[1] + 15/255 and newcolor.g > basecolor[2] - 15/255 and newcolor.g < basecolor[2] + 15/255 then
					bg.BackgroundColor3 = newcolor
				end
			end
		end
		wait(1/30)
	end
end))

local friendids = {}

function SetVisiblePaintings()
	if view.Value == 0 then --nobody
		for _,v in pairs(workspace.ArtCanvases:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= plr.Name then
				v.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.ArtCanvases
			end
		end
	elseif view.Value == 1 then --friends
		for _,v in pairs(workspace.ArtCanvases:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= plr.Name then
				v.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.ArtCanvases
			end
		end
		for _,v in pairs(friendids) do
			local target = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(v)
			if target and target:FindFirstChild("CanUserChat") and target.CanUserChat.Value == true then
				local paintmodel = game.ReplicatedStorage.ArtCanvases:FindFirstChild(target.Name)
				if paintmodel then
					paintmodel.Parent = workspace.ArtCanvases
				end
			end
		end
	elseif view.Value == 2 then
		for _,v in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.ArtCanvases:GetChildren()) do
			v.Parent = workspace.ArtCanvases
		end
	end
	local personalpaint = game.ReplicatedStorage.ArtCanvases:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
	if personalpaint then
		personalpaint.Parent = workspace.ArtCanvases
	end
end

script.Name = "core"

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()

--// Settings

local SplashSound = 142431247

local rFunction = game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.fishUpdate

if not game.Workspace:findFirstChild("FishRodBin") then
	Bin = Instance.new("Backpack", game.Workspace)
	Bin.Name = "FishRodBin"
else
	Bin = game.Workspace.FishRodBin
end

local Tool = script.Parent
local WireStart = Tool:WaitForChild("Tip")

--// Initialisation

local Part, Wire, Catching, Enabled = nil, nil, false, false

--// Functions

function DrawFromPoints(a, b)
	if Wire then
		Wire:Destroy()
	end
	Wire = Instance.new('Part',Bin)
	Wire.CanCollide = false
	Wire.Anchored = true
	Wire.BrickColor = BrickColor.new('Light stone grey')
	Wire.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
	Wire.Size = Vector3.new(.4, 0, .2)
	
	local Mesh = Instance.new('CylinderMesh', Wire)
	Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0.3)
	
	Wire.Size = Vector3.new(1,(a - b).magnitude, 0.3)
	Wire.CFrame = CFrame.new(a, b) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(a - b).magnitude / 2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)
	
	game.Debris:AddItem(Wire, 60)
end

function throw()

function teleport(locationname)
	local locations = workspace:WaitForChild("TeleportLocations")
	local location = locations:FindFirstChild(locationname)
	if locationname:match("!home_") then
		location = workspace:FindFirstChild(locationname)
		if location and checkIfStanding(plr.Character) then
			location = location.Floor.CFrame + (location.Floor.CFrame.lookVector * 32) + Vector3.new(0,4,0)
		end
	elseif location then
		location = location.CFrame
	end
	if locationname:match("spawn_") then
		local teamname = string.sub(locationname,7)
		for _,v in pairs(game.Teams:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == teamname then
				for _,x in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if x:IsA("SpawnLocation") and x.TeamColor == v.TeamColor and checkIfStanding(plr.Character) then
						location = x.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,4,0)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if location then
		local char = plr.Character
		if char ~= nil and char.Parent ~= nil and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			if checkIfStanding(char) == true then
				char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = location
			else
				standUp(char)
				wait(1/20)
				if checkIfStanding(char) == true then
					char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = location
					char.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local marketplace = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local assetid = game.ReplicatedStorage.CashProducts[script.Parent.Name].Value

local baseprice = game.ReplicatedStorage.CashProducts[script.Parent.Name].BasePrice.Value

local gui = script.Parent.Parent.Parent --the Frame frame
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer

script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:connect(function()
	marketplace:PromptProductPurchase(plr,assetid)
end)

local asset 

pcall(function()
	asset = marketplace:GetProductInfo(assetid,Enum.InfoType.Product)
end)

if asset == nil then
	repeat wait(60) pcall(function()
		asset = marketplace:GetProductInfo(assetid,Enum.InfoType.Product)
	end)
	until asset ~= nil
end

function onMouseEnter()
	gui.Desc.ItemDesc.Text = desc
	gui.Desc.ItemName.Text = itemname
	if asset then
		if asset.PriceInRobux < baseprice then --sale
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = "Price: "..baseprice.." R$"
			gui.Desc.DiscountSlash.Visible = true
			gui.Desc.ItemCostDiscounted.Text = asset.PriceInRobux.." R$"
			gui.Desc.Savings.Text = "You save: "..baseprice - asset.PriceInRobux.." R$!"
			
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.TextTransparency = .5
		else
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = "Price: "..asset.PriceInRobux.." R$"
			gui.Desc.DiscountSlash.Visible = false
			gui.Desc.ItemCostDiscounted.Text = ""
			gui.Desc.Savings.Text = ""
			
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.TextStrokeTransparency = .7
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.TextTransparency = 0
		end
	else
		gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = ""
	end
end

if plr:FindFirstChild("GamepadMode") then
	local selection = gui:WaitForChild("GamepadSelection")
	selection.Changed:connect(function(obj)
		if obj == script.Parent then
			onMouseEnter()
		end
	end)
end

script.Parent.MouseEnter:connect(onMouseEnter)

			end
			gui.NumberLabel.Text = "#"..i
			gui.Position = gui.Position + UDim2.new((#outfitslots:GetChildren() - 1)*.33,0,0,0)
			gui.Name = i
			gui.Parent = outfitslots

	setOutfitPageColors()

function getClothingId(valueobj)
	if valueobj.Value ~= 0 then
		local asset
		local origid = valueobj.Value
		pcall(function()
			asset = mp:GetProductInfo(origid)
		end)
		if asset then
			local creator = asset.Creator.CreatorTargetId
			local count = 0
			local success
			local clothingasset
			local groups
			repeat
				pcall(function() clothingasset = mp:GetProductInfo(origid+(count+1)) end)
				if clothingasset and (clothingasset.AssetTypeId == 11 or clothingasset.AssetTypeId == 12) then
					if clothingasset.Creator.CreatorTargetId == creator then
						--surefire hit
						success = true
					elseif clothingasset.Creator.CreatorType == "Group" then
						if groups == nil then
							pcall(function()
								groups = game:GetService("GroupService"):GetGroupsAsync(creator)
							end)
						end
						if groups then
							for _,entry in pairs(groups) do
								if entry["Id"] == clothingasset.Creator.CreatorTargetId then
									success = true
									break
								end
							end
						end
					else
						clothingasset = nil
					end
				else
					clothingasset = nil
				end
				count = count + 1
			until success == true or count > 25
			if success == true then
				valueobj.Value = origid + count
			else
				print("failed to load clothing asset")
			end
		end
	end
end

function commanumber(num)
	local num = tostring(num)
	local i = 0
	local finalstring = ""
	for n in string.gmatch(num,"%d") do
		finalstring = finalstring..n
		i = i + 1
		if (#num - i) % 3 == 0 and i ~= #num then
			finalstring = finalstring..","
		end
	end
	return finalstring
end

function GetTimeString(timeleft)
	if timeleft < 0 then
		return "Ends now!"
	end
	
	local d, h, m, s 
	
	d = math.floor(timeleft / 86400)
	if d == 0 then
		d = ""
	else
		d = d..":"
	end
	
	h = math.floor((timeleft / 3600) % 24)
	if h < 10 then
		if h == 0 then
			if d == "" then
				h = ""
			else
				h = "00:"
			end
		else
			if d == "" then
				h = h..":"
			else
				h = "0"..h..":"
			end
		end
	else
		h = h..":"
	end
	
	m = math.floor((timeleft / 60) % 60)
	if m < 10 then
		if m == 0 then
			if h == "" then
				m = "0:"
			else
				m = "00:"
			end
		else
			if h == "" then
				m = m..":"
			else
				m = "0"..m..":"
			end
		end
	else
		m = m..":"
	end
	
	s = timeleft % 60
	if s < 10 then
		s = "0"..s
	end
	
	return d..h..m..s
end

function IsTeamMate(Player1, Player2)
	return (Player1 and Player2 and not Player1.Neutral and not Player2.Neutral and Player1.TeamColor == Player2.TeamColor)
end

function GetTotalParts(MaxParts, PossibleParts, Parts)
	if MaxParts < PossibleParts then
		return MaxParts
	elseif Parts >= MaxParts then
		return 0
	elseif MaxParts >= PossibleParts then
		local PartCount = (MaxParts - PossibleParts)
		if Parts <= MaxParts then
			PartCount = (MaxParts - Parts)
			if PartCount > PossibleParts then
				return PossibleParts
			else
				return PartCount
			end
		elseif PartCount >= PossibleParts then
			return PossibleParts
		else
			return PartCount
		end
	end
end

function GetParts(Region, MaxParts, Ignore)
	local Parts = {}
	local RerunFailed = false
	while #Parts < MaxParts and not RerunFailed do
		local Region = Region
		local PossibleParts = GetTotalParts(MaxParts, 100, #Parts)
		local PartsNearby = game:GetService("Workspace"):FindPartsInRegion3WithIgnoreList(Region, Ignore, PossibleParts)
		if #PartsNearby == 0 then
			RerunFailed = true
		else
			for i, v in pairs(PartsNearby) do
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				table.insert(Ignore, v)
			end
		end
	end
	return Parts
end

function getAllEdges()
        local edges = {}
       
        for _,axis in next,Enum.Axis:GetEnumItems() do
                local faces = {Vector3.FromAxis(axis), -Vector3.FromAxis(axis)}
                               
                for _,face in next,faces do
                        for _,normalId in next,Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do
                                normalId = Vector3.FromNormalId(normalId)
                                if normalId ~= faces[1] and normalId ~= faces[2] then
                                        edges[tostring(face+normalId)] = {face, normalId}
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
       
        for index,edgeData in next,edges do
                table.insert(edges, edgeData)
                edges[index] = nil
        end
       
        return edges
end
 
function getEdgeData(object, edges, thickness)
        for index,edgeData in next,edges do
                local face1,face2 = unpack(edgeData)
                local combined = face1+face2
                local unused = Vector3.new(1,1,1) - absVector(combined)
               
                local edgeSize = (size(object) * unused) + (Vector3.new(1,1,1) * thickness)
                local edgeCFrame = cframe(object) * CFrame.new((size(object) / 2) * combined)
               
                edges[index] = {edgeCFrame, edgeSize}
        end
       
        return edges
end

function FindButtonInGui(instance)
	local button
	local function recurse(instance)
		for _,v in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("GuiButton") and v.Visible and v.Name ~= "CloseButton" then
				button = v
				return
			else
				if (v:IsA("GuiButton") or v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) and v.Visible then
					recurse(v)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	recurse(instance)
	return button
end

	for _,v in pairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then

		end
	end

		if frame.Visible == false then return end
		if not instant then

function getAmount()
	local num = math.random(1,#Fishes)

	if rare ~= 10 then
		for i,v in pairs(Fishes) do
			if i == num then
				return v,i
			end
		end
	else
		return "Eel",6
	end
end
	
--// Main

function AddToWaitlist(plr)
	table.insert(waitlist,plr.Name)
	wait(25)
	table.remove(waitlist,1)
end

function CheckHax(plr)
	local count = 0
	for _,v in pairs(waitlist) do
		if v == plr.Name then
			count = count + 1
		end
	end
	if count >= 10 then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function IsAlreadyBanned(plr)
	for _,v in pairs(alreadybanned) do
		if v == plr.Name then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function FU.OnServerInvoke(invoker,pid)
	if invoker then
		if pid == nil or invoker.userId ~= pid then
			if invoker.userId > 0 then
				if not IsAlreadyBanned(invoker) then
					table.insert(alreadybanned,invoker.Name)
					game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.BanPlayer:Fire(invoker.userId, 500, "You have been banned.", true)
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if CheckHax(invoker) == true then
			if invoker.userId > 0 then
				if not IsAlreadyBanned(invoker) then
					table.insert(alreadybanned,invoker.Name)
					game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.BanPlayer:Fire(invoker.userId, 500, "You have been banned.", true)
				end
			end
			return
		end
		local fish,price = getAmount()
		game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.Fishing.Value = game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.Fishing.Value + price
		game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.ChangeCash:Fire(invoker,price)
		coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(AddToWaitlist),invoker)
		return fish,price
	end
end

	if caller == nil or target == nil or friendlists[caller.Name] == nil or friendlists[target.Name] == nil then return false end
	local f1 = false
	local f2 = false
	for _,v in pairs(friendlists[caller.Name]) do
		if v == target.userId then
			f1 = true
			break
		end
	end
	for _,v in pairs(friendlists[target.Name]) do
		if v == caller.userId then
			f2 = true
			break
		end
	end
	if f1 == true and f2 == true then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

	local om = math.acos(math.min(1, v1:Dot(v2)))
	return ((om < 0.01 and ((1 - t) * v1 + t * v2)) or ((math.sin((1 - t) * om) / math.sin(om)) * v1 + (math.sin(t * om) / math.sin(om)) * v2))
end

	return setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(tb, child)
			return function()
				while not parent:FindFirstChild(child) do 
					parent.ChildAdded:wait()
				end
				return parent:FindFirstChild(child)			
			end
		end;
	})

local oncooldown = false

function onUnequip()
	if Sound then
		playSong("")
	end
end

function onActivate()
	Remote:FireClient(getPlayer(), "ChooseSong")
end

function getPlayer()
	return game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Tool.Parent)
end

function playSong(id)
	if oncooldown then return end
	id = id or ""
	if id ~= "" and tostring(id):match("%D") then return end --stop if there's non-digit chars
	
	if id ~= "" then
		local asset
		
		coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
			oncooldown = true
			wait(6)
			oncooldown = false
		end))
		
		pcall(function() asset = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(id) end)
		if asset == nil then
			return nil
		end
		
		if asset.AssetTypeId ~= 3 then
			return nil
		end
		
		Sound.SoundId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..id
		Sound:Play()
	else
		Sound.SoundId = ""
		Sound:Stop()
	end
end

	if player ~= getPlayer() then return end
	
	if func == "Activate" then
		onActivate(...)
	end
	
	if func == "PlaySong" then
		playSong(...)
	end
end

function RemoveModel()
	if Removing then
		return
	end
	local Parts = {}

		end

	if #Parts == 0 then

		Model.Name = ""

	end

-- Returns all objects under instance with Transparency
local function GetTransparentsRecursive(instance, partsTable)
	local partsTable = partsTable or {}
	for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
		if (child:IsA('BasePart') and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart") or child:IsA('Decal') then
			table.insert(partsTable, child)
		end
		GetTransparentsRecursive(child, partsTable)
	end
	return partsTable
end

-- Returns a character ancestor and its Humanoid, or nil
local function FindCharacterAncestor(subject)
	if subject and subject ~= Workspace then
		local humanoid = subject:FindFirstChild('Humanoid')
		if humanoid then
			return subject, humanoid
		else
			return FindCharacterAncestor(subject.Parent)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Waits for parent.child to exist, then returns it
local function WaitForChild(parent, childName)
	assert(parent, "ERROR: WaitForChild: parent is nil")
	while not parent:FindFirstChild(childName) do parent.ChildAdded:wait() end
	return parent[childName]
end
